scope: Read-only source performance audit; only audit report/evidence files authored by this task.

environment.profile: Cargo bench/release, opt-level 3, static CRT from .cargo/config.toml

limitations: Physical host model, thermal state and unrelated system activity were not continuously controlled.
No other audit build/test ran during the benchmark series; audit subagents were asked to stop shell work.
Windows UI, GPU transfer, Present, and physical scanout were not measured by these Core-only runs.
Rustup emitted 'could not canonicalize path C:\Users\shuichi' during Cargo commands, which nevertheless exited 0.
